messages.subject: Scan costs - proposal for a usage-based add-on
messages.body:
Quick recap:

1. Problem: scan volume per account varies by a factor of 30. Our heaviest Starter accounts (four courier companies doing parcel intake scanning) each process 40,000+ scans/month, and infra + storage cost us real money per scan, while every account pays the same flat fee.
2. Cost data: the top 12 scan-heavy accounts cost us 3-4x more to serve than the Starter median.
3. Proposal: a usage-based "Scan Pack" add-on at €0.08 per scan beyond a generous free allowance. Alternatives considered: (a) flat-rate add-on at €99/month - but it penalises light users and gives the heavy users no reason to reduce; (b) raising plan prices across the board - unfair to the 90% who barely scan.
4. Billing impact: Dev has confirmed our usage metering can expose a per-account scan counter, so invoicing a per-unit line item is feasible. Ledgerly supports metered line items natively, which helps from July.

Thoughts welcome - I would like to move this to pricing review this week.

Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: RE: Scan costs - proposal for a usage-based add-on
messages.body:
Dear Marta, dear Priya,

From a finance perspective I welcome the direction: usage-based components align revenue with the actual cost to serve, and our gross margin on the scan-heavy cohort is presently the weakest in the book. I would gently suggest two conditions before launch: first, that we model the revenue on the assumption that at least a few heavy users reduce their scan volume once it is metered, because some will; second, that the free allowance is set so that at least 80% of accounts see no change whatsoever on their invoice.

On the €0.08 rate itself I have no objection; it is defensible against our unit costs.

Kind regards,
Helen Oyelaran
Chief Financial Officer, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Scan costs - proposal for a usage-based add-on
messages.body:
Quick recap:

1. Scan Pack at €0.08/scan, flat rate, with a free allowance set above normal usage (I will propose the exact number after one more data pull). 2. Dev: metering is ready, dashboards to be built with the billing change. 3. Helen: 80% of accounts must be unaffected; revenue modelled on reduced heavy usage. 4. Tomás: pilot with two prospects first. 

All feedback incorporated into the pricing review doc. Marta - with your go, spec goes to the team Friday and billing work slots after the June close.

Thanks!
Priya
